name: tether_v002
hypothesis: A bounded learned motor residual can reduce payload tracking error and swing relative to the privileged PD baseline under seeded initial disturbances and wind.
notes: Lower-memory single-process rollouts after v001 subprocess smoke terminated with host allocation error. Privileged state plus PD baseline, not camera-only or independent control. CPU MuJoCo rollouts, CUDA policy updates. First feasibility run, not SOTA.
